edges.fact: The user recently got a new 50mm prime lens that has been working out great and uses it with their Nikon D5600
The user has an old 18-55mm kit lens for their Nikon D5600 that has been having issues, forcing reliance on manual focus
The Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW's main compartment can fit the Nikon D5600 with the 50mm prime lens attached plus additional lenses such as the 18-55mm kit lens, and also fits a 15-inch laptop

The Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L's main compartment can fit the Nikon D5600 with the 50mm prime lens attached and a few additional lenses, though with slightly smaller capacity and a 13-inch laptop sleeve
The Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L has a smaller capacity and less weather protection than the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW

edges.source_entity_name: Gitzo GT3543LS Systematic Series 3 Carbon Fiber Tripod
edges.fact: The Gitzo GT3543LS Systematic Series 3 Carbon Fiber Tripod supports up to 39.7 lbs (18 kg), more than enough for the Nikon D5600 and lenses, and costs around $800-$900
The Really Right Stuff TVC-34L Tripod supports up to 50 lbs (23 kg), suitable for the Nikon D5600 and heavier camera setups, and costs around $1,000-$1,100
The Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 Carbon Fiber Tripod supports up to 35.3 lbs (16 kg), sufficient for the Nikon D5600 and lenses, and costs around $600-$700
The Davis & Sanford Travel Tripod is a budget-friendly option supporting up to 25 lbs (11 kg), sufficient for the Nikon D5600 and lenses, and costs around $200-$300
The user is considering the Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 Carbon Fiber Tripod as a replacement for their old Manfrotto BeFree tripod, which is showing signs of wear and tear
The user is planning to upgrade their camera body from the Nikon D5600 to a full-frame model like the Nikon Z6 in the future
The Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 Carbon Fiber Tripod, with its 35.3 lbs (16 kg) maximum load capacity, is suitable for a full-frame Nikon Z6 and most lenses used with it
The Nikon MC-36a Multi-Function Remote Cord is a wired remote shutter release specifically designed for Nikon cameras including the Nikon D5600
CamRanger, a wireless Wi-Fi remote shutter release with camera control, live view, and focus stacking, is compatible with many Nikon cameras including the Nikon D5600
